item.title: Pretty! The Martin K. Dahl House, Circa 1879 in Wisconsin. $349,900
item.description: I love Second Empire style houses! This one has pretty details! It is known as the Martin K. Dahl House. It was built in 1879. It is located on .52 acre in Waupun, Wisconsin. The house features double front doors, wood floors, wainscoting, crown moulding, wide baseboards, picture rails and crystal chandeliers. There is a detached carriage house on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,430 square feet. $349,900 Contact Greg Holz: 920–960-1710 From the Zillow listing: The Martin K. Dahl

item.title: Lots of potential! Five acres in Alabama. $349,000
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! It could definitely use some updating and some undoing of past renovations. The house was built in the late 1800’s. It is located on five acres in Ashville, Alabama. The house features a covered front porch, balcony, carport, multiple detached buildings and baseboards. item.description: Welcome to Kansas’s most expensive old house listing! That atrium is perfect! Would live in that room. The house was built in 1910. It is located on 30.47 acres in Shawnee, Kansas. The property features a main house, barn, pastures, horse barn, two car garage with guest apartment, in-ground pool and a large pond. There are multiple updates to the house. item.description: This house has interesting terrain and scenery! The house was built in 1951. It is located on .31 acre in Twentynine Palms, California. The house features a large covered porch, stone chimney, fenced in yard, large stone fireplace and baseboards. Not a fan of some of the flooring or the carpeting. item.title: I want the bed! Pretty woodwork! Circa 1895 in Connecticut. $499,000
item.description: I want that bed! This house has some pretty woodwork! Love the staircase! The house was built in 1895. It is located on .43 acre in Killingly, Connecticut. The house features a covered wrap around porch, wood floors, pocket doors, grand staircase, stained glass windows, crown moulding, crystal chandelier, built-in bookshelves and wide baseboards. Five bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,346 square feet. $499,000 Contact Amy L. Brunet with Brunet and Company Real Estate: 860-234-0434 From the Zillow l

item.title: Pretty setting! Almost three acres in Florida. Multiple outbuildings! $260,000
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! Love that there are outbuildings! The house was built in 1925. It is located on 2.8 acres in Havana, Florida. The house features a covered front porch, great screen door, knotty pine cabinets, parquet flooring, wainscoting and baseboards. I bet there are wood floors underneath the carpeting. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,763 square feet. $260,000 Contact Elizabeth A. Handlewich with Florida Luxury Realty: 850

item.title: A lot of house for the money! Circa 1890 in Georgia. $175,000
item.description: This sure seems like a lot of house for the money! Love the wrought iron fencing and the porch. The house was built in 1890. It is located on .3 acre in Albany, Georgia. The house features wrought iron fencing, a large covered front porch, a porte cochere, upper porch, tall ceilings, wood floors, coffered ceiling, baseboards, pocket doors, built-in bookshelves, sunroom and claw foot tubs. There is a spacious backyard with a large brick patio. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,102 square feet.

item.title: Has a pool! Circa 1900 in Illinois. $285,000
item.description: Neat idea for an above ground pool! Pretty house with a great porch! This is a big house with almost 4,000 square feet. The house was built in 1900. It is located in Fairfield, Illinois. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, pocket doors, leaded glass transom window, baseboards and a grand staircase. There is a large above ground pool with a bar area. The property has a detached garage. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,983 square feet. $285,000 Contact Katie Matthews

item.title: Beautiful staircase! Circa 1890 in Indiana. $289,900
item.description: This house has a beautiful staircase inside! Pretty woodwork too. The house was built in 1890. It is located on .25 acre in Auburn, Indiana. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, french doors, baseboards, beautiful front door with leaded glass, grand staircase, wainscoting, vintage light fixtures, great kitchen sink and exposed brick. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,132 square feet. $289,900 Contact Michelle Snyder with North Eastern Realty Group: 260-615-6289 From the Zillow

item.title: Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! The Saban Estate. $4,995,000
item.description: Welcome to Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! Known as the Saban Estate, It was built in 1953. It is located on 5.38 acres in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. I love the grounds of this property. There is a beautiful pool, pretty gardens and mature landscaping. There is a lighted sports court and a resort style in-ground pool.
